sm_top.sm: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu closed the West Bank following a thwarted potential major attack.
Reports indicate an apparent airstrike against Pickaxe Mountain and other targets in Iran is underway.
Attacks and intercepted missiles and drones targeting King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, resulting in casualties and subsequent deaths from injuries.
Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island and Bandar Abbas in Iran following a US strike.
Iran's IRGC claims responsibility for Hormuz tanker explosions and the downing of a drone.
President Trump announced that the U.S. will stop providing Israel $4 billion in annual military aid.
The US approved a possible foreign military sale of Patriot PAC-3 missiles to Ukraine.
Ukrainian officials reported that the death toll from a Russian attack on an aid center in the Zaporizhzhia region has risen to 37.
Ukrainian drones struck the Ufa refinery, causing a fire.
A vessel was struck by an unknown projectile near the Strait of Hormuz, with 25 crew members evacuated by Oman.
Russia launched massive missile and drone strikes targeting Ukrainian energy infrastructure, causing casualties and power outages.
Israeli strikes killed four Palestinians in Gaza.
A Russian strike on a hospital in Kharkiv injured 73 people.
Iran claims it downed a US drone over Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.
The United States deployed a Patriot missile defense system and refueling aircraft to Israel.
A bomb attack in western Colombia killed four people, including an infant.
Ethiopia has taken delivery of 12 Russian Su-35 fighter jets and is set to receive S-400 air defense systems.
Russia launched hundreds of missiles and drones targeting Ukraine's energy infrastructure.
Drone attacks struck power stations across Sudan, triggering widespread outages.
US forces conducted strikes on Iranian targets along the Strait of Hormuz.
Ukrainian forces launched a drone strike hitting a Russian oil refinery.
Russian strikes on Dnipro killed two people and injured 20 others, damaging residential and medical facilities.
Russian strikes hit Ukraine following an earlier strike on an aid point that killed 37.
The WHO chief reported that attacks in Ethiopia have killed civilians and brought the health system near collapse.
US forces carried out a strike on Qeshm Island in Iran.
Houthi ballistic missile strikes killed at least 73 recruits at a military camp in Yemen's Shabwah province.
An employee at the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant was killed in a drone attack.
At least 19 people were killed as the Venezuelan military attacked a Colombian rebel camp.
Russian attacks hit Ternopil and Rivne oblasts, targeting a residential building and an energy facility.
Russian air defenses repelled large overnight drone attacks targeting Moscow and multiple regions.
Russian forces attacked an energy facility in Khmelnytskyi Oblast, causing power cuts.
Russian airstrike on Komyshuvakha killed 40 people, with over 30 trapped under rubble.
A Houthi missile attack on Al-Allaf camp in Yemen's al-Dhale governorate caused dozens of casualties.
The Gaza Government Media Office reported 1,593 killed and 5,748 injured in Israeli ceasefire violations.
A drone strike hit a gas station in South Kordofan, killing at least 7 civilians and injuring 36 others.
Russia launched its biggest mass attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure this year, hitting a substation critical for a nuclear power plant, and struck a Kharkiv medical facility
Dozens remain missing following a deadly Russian guided-bomb attack in southern Ukraine.
TEC-5 Thermal Power Plant in Kharkov City struck by Russian ballistic missiles and glide bombs.
A Houthi missile strike on a health center in Yemen resulted in multiple deaths and injuries.
Saudi airstrikes hit a Yemeni port and oil facility, wounding seven people.
